title: 第一卷 人生初见 第十五章 晚宴第一卷 人生初见 第十六章 变故
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
长孙问天就这样轻易的将信拿在手上把玩。
南宫傲此时才如释重负，一下瘫坐在旁边的椅子上，喘着粗气。
人们此时才反应过来，这信里说的老匹夫就是长孙问天。长孙问天竟然跟游子相识，而且看信里的意思还交情不浅。
此刻场间众家主心思又活络了起来。
没有提前站队的人此刻庆幸无比，现在示好长孙问天也算是雪中送炭了；而刚才已经站了队的家主此刻也是想着怎样赶紧更弦易辙。
南宫傲此刻总算平静了下来，也知道了这谋划多年的果子今天怕是要落地扎根长成另一株参天大树了，只是依旧姓长孙不姓南宫。
会议自此也没有了什么悬念，速度便也快了，而南宫傲更是提前愤然离场，只是这次没有人再去劝阻。
长孙到现在还感觉有些迷糊，没有想到今天一波三折竟然达到了自己都没敢想的效果。
先是万万没想到南宫傲竟然达到了御者之境，而后万万没想到红袖阁竟实力如此之强，而且司琴竟然会在关键时刻出手帮自己，最后更是没想到爷爷竟然跟游子相识而且交情不浅。
会议结束后各大家主都揣着自己的心思匆匆离场，今天的结果出乎了所有人预料，也得到了许多消息，回去之后各大家主还要研究这些得来的消息。
长孙趁司琴还未离去便拦住了她，向司琴表达了谢意。
红袖阁帮助了自己，这份情长孙自然承下了。
“说实话，看到南宫傲御空而立的那一刻，我都已经认为今天输定了，没想到司琴姑娘能在这时伸出援手。长孙在这里谢过司琴姑娘以及海家了。”长孙说罢对着司琴以及海家鞠了一躬表示感谢。
看着长孙此刻情真意切的道谢，司琴暗叹一声没有帮错人，嘴上也是推让了一番之后便离开了。
长孙将司琴以及海家送到大门，目送离开。
看着越走越远的马车，长孙心中回顾着今天族会上发生的一切，也暗暗为红袖阁背后隐藏的势力而惊叹，还好现在他跟红袖阁似友非敌。
长孙回到府内后，便听到长孙问天畅快的大笑声。这么多年压在长孙问天心头的一块石头今天终于被搬开了。
“孙儿，来让爷爷看看，今天的事真是畅快啊。但最让我惊喜的还是你啊，没想到你能找来这么厉害的帮手。而且自己实力也不错，进步很快啊。这心思也很缜密，沉得住气，好，就是好啊，哈哈。”长孙问天此刻看着长孙就像是看着块宝似的，哪哪都好，嘴上更是夸个没完。
看得出来长孙问天今天是真的很开心。
看着长孙问天畅快的大笑，长孙无奈的摇摇头，心里不过也是跟长孙问天一样高兴。

“倒是爷爷你给了我个惊喜，早说你认识游子不就完了么，也省的我跑前跑后的，碰了一鼻子灰。”
“哈哈，游子是我多年前的好友，已经很久没联系了。这次也没想到他真的会帮我，况且不这样的话我怎么能看到孙儿如此精彩的表演。”长孙问天说道。
“你当这是表演啊，我可是紧张的心都到嗓子眼了，还是您心大。”长孙白了一眼说道。
长孙问天也不生气，只是哈哈笑。
“行了，不说这个了。今天高兴，设宴，咱们要庆祝一下。老孙呢，吩咐一下，晚上设宴。”长孙问天叫来孙管家，吩咐下去晚上设宴的事。
看着孙伯下去忙晚宴的事，长孙也便离去了，此刻长孙急着把好消息告诉初黎。
长孙一推开门便看到初黎像热锅上的蚂蚁一样在房子里转来转去，这一刻长孙感到今天的一切都值得了。
爷爷因此而高兴，这里还有个小丫头时时刻刻为自己而担心，这一刻的温暖让长孙沉迷，以至于不忍心叫住初黎将此破坏。
此刻的初黎让长孙忽然沦陷，她那稚嫩的脸庞上焦急的表情是如何都表演不出的，所有的感情都发自肺腑，那惊慌失措的眼神就像失去了主心骨的孩子，是那么的无助，让人情不自禁的想要保护；因为着急而急促的呼吸让鼻翼一扇一扇的，又像是生气的小牛犊，竟是那么的可爱；还有青葱般细直的手指放在齿间摩擦，她是真的为长孙着急，以至于在象牙般洁白的玉指上留下了红色的齿印都毫无知觉。
长孙就这样看的入迷，初黎就这样为长孙着急的出神。
直到长孙回过神才感觉初黎这样为自己着急，而自己竟这样欣赏的入神好像有些不妥，方才清了清嗓子咳了一声。
此刻初黎才发现长孙已经出现在门口，那一瞬间初黎好像是迷路的人找到了世界的中心，一口气涌上胸中想要呐喊出来；又好像溺水的人终于上了岸，死里逃生的想要松口气。
content_en:
Changsun Wentian easily took the letter in his hand and played with it.
Nangong Ao was relieved at this moment and slumped down on the chair next to him, breathing heavily.
Only then did people realize that the old man mentioned in the letter was Changsun Wentian. Changsun Wentian actually knew Youzi, and judging from the letter, they were quite close friends.
At this moment, the minds of all the family heads in the room became active again.
Those who had not joined the team in advance were extremely happy at the moment, and now showing their goodwill to Changsun Wentian was a timely help; while the family heads who had already joined the team just now were thinking about how to quickly change their tune.
Nangong Ao finally calmed down at this moment, and he also knew that the fruit he had planned for many years would probably take root and grow into another towering tree today, but his surname would still be Changsun and not Nangong.
From then on, the meeting had no suspense, and the speed became faster. Nangong Ao even left the meeting angrily in advance, but this time no one tried to dissuade him.
The eldest grandson still feels a little confused. He didn't expect that today's twists and turns would achieve an effect that he didn't even dare to think of.
First, he never expected that Nangong Ao would reach the realm of a charioteer. Then he never expected that Hongxiuge Pavilion would be so powerful, and that Siqin would help him at a critical moment. Finally, he never expected that grandpa would actually know and have a close friendship with Youzi.
After the meeting, all the masters hurriedly left with their own thoughts. Today's results were beyond everyone's expectations, and a lot of news was obtained. After returning, the masters will have to study the news.
Changsun stopped Siqin before she left and expressed his gratitude to Siqin.
Hongxiu Pavilion helped him, and Sun naturally accepted this love.
"To be honest, the moment I saw Nangong Ao standing in the sky, I already thought I was doomed today. I didn't expect Miss Siqin to lend a helping hand at this time. The eldest grandson is here to thank Miss Siqin and the Hai family." After that, the eldest grandson bowed to Siqin and the Hai family to express his gratitude.
Seeing Changsun's sincere thanks at this moment, Si Qin sighed to himself that he had not helped the wrong person, and left after giving in to him.
The eldest grandson sent Siqin and the Hai family to the gate and watched them leave.
Watching the carriage going further and further away, Changsun reviewed everything that happened at today's clan meeting in his mind, and secretly marveled at the hidden power behind Hongxiuge. Fortunately, he and Hongxiuge now seemed like friends rather than enemies.
After the eldest grandson returned to the house, he heard the eldest grandson Wentian's hearty laughter. The stone that had been weighing on Changsun Wentian's heart for so many years was finally lifted today.
"Grandson, let me show you what happened today. But what surprises me the most is you. I didn't expect you to find such a powerful helper. Moreover, you are also very strong and making rapid progress. You are also very thoughtful and calm. It's good, it's good, haha." Changsun Wentian looked at his eldest grandson as if he were looking at a piece of treasure. Everything is good, and he couldn't stop praising it.
It can be seen that Changsun Wentian is really happy today.
Seeing Changsun Wentian laughing heartily, Changsun shook his head helplessly, feeling just as happy as Changsun Wentian.
"Grandpa, you gave me a surprise. If you had told me you knew the wanderer, it would have been over. It also saved me from running around and getting into trouble."
"Haha, Youzi is a good friend of mine many years ago, and I haven't contacted him for a long time. I didn't expect him to really help me this time. Besides, how could I have seen such a wonderful performance from my grandson otherwise," Changsun Wentian said.
"You think this is a performance, I'm so nervous that I'm in my throat, but you're still too big-hearted." Changsun rolled his eyes and said.
Changsun Wentian wasn't angry either, he just laughed.
"Okay, let's not talk about it anymore. We are happy today and have a banquet. We want to celebrate. As for Lao Sun, please give me instructions to have a banquet tonight." Changsun Wentian called Butler Sun and gave instructions about the banquet that night.
Seeing Uncle Sun going down to attend to the dinner, the eldest grandson alsoAfter leaving, Changsun was anxious to tell Chu Li the good news.
As soon as the eldest grandson opened the door, he saw Chu Li walking around the house like an ant on a hot pot. At this moment, the eldest grandson felt that everything today was worth it.
Grandpa was happy because of this. There was a little girl here who was worried about him all the time. The warmth of this moment made the eldest grandson so addicted that he couldn't bear to ask Chu Li to destroy it.
At this moment, Chu Li suddenly fell into despair. The anxious expression on her immature face could not be expressed in any way. All the emotions came from the heart. Her panic-stricken eyes were like a child who had lost her backbone. She was so helpless that people couldn't help but want to protect; because Her anxious and rapid breathing made her nostrils flap, and she looked like an angry calf, which was so cute; and she rubbed her green onion-like thin straight fingers between her teeth. She was really worried about her eldest grandson, so much so that she was unaware of the red tooth marks left on her ivory-white jade fingers.
The eldest grandson was fascinated by what he saw, and Chu Li was so worried about the eldest grandson.
It wasn't until Changsun came back to his senses that he felt that Chu Li was so anxious for him, and that it seemed a little inappropriate for him to be so absorbed in admiring him, so he cleared his throat and coughed.
At this moment, Chu Li realized that his grandson had appeared at the door. At that moment, Chu Li seemed like a lost person who had found the center of the world, and a breath welled up in his chest and wanted to shout out; it was also like a drowning person who finally made it to the shore and wanted to breathe a sigh of relief after escaping death.
